_comment: Maps human-friendly truck_model_id text to a model ID or a truck class. Keys are matched case-insensitively and ignore punctuation (so 'Bolero-Pickup', 'bolero pickup', 'BOLERO/PICKUP' all match the 'bolero pickup' key). Each value is either a model ID from truck-models.json (applies that model's mileage) or a truck-class ID from truck-rates.json. Add your own aliases here anytime.
